name: worldlabs-mcp
description: MCP server wrapping the World Labs Marble API for 3D world generation and the Spark 2.0 spatial viewer

tools.name: generate_world_from_text
tools.description: Generate a 3D world from a text description (marble-1.1 / marble-1.1-plus)

tools.name: generate_world_from_image
tools.description: Generate a 3D world from a public image URL (panorama supported)

tools.name: generate_world_from_multi_image
tools.description: Generate a 3D world from multiple images at known azimuth angles

tools.name: generate_world_from_video
tools.description: Generate a 3D world from a public video URL

tools.name: upload_and_generate
tools.description: Upload a local image/video file and generate end-to-end (GCS signed URL flow)

tools.name: prepare_media_upload
tools.description: Step 1 of the manual upload flow: signed GCS upload URL + media asset id

tools.name: generate_world_from_media_asset
tools.description: Step 2 of the manual upload flow: generate from an uploaded media asset id

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Single poll of an async generation operation status

tools.name: wait_for_world
tools.description: Blocking poll until a generation operation completes or times out

tools.name: list_worlds
tools.description: Paginated list of generated worlds

tools.name: get_world
tools.description: World details + time-limited asset URLs (SPZ, GLB, panorama, thumbnail)

tools.name: delete_world
tools.description: Permanently delete a world and all associated assets

tools.name: broadcast_spatial_notification
tools.description: Speak TTS text at a 3D coordinate via the Spark spatial bridge

tools.name: broadcast_spatial_audio
tools.description: Place a looping audio source at 3D coordinates in the scene

tools.name: place_world_tv
tools.description: Spawn a 16:9 virtual TV screen playing a video in the scene

tools.name: spawn_agent_avatar
tools.description: Materialize an animated agent avatar in the scene

tools.name: refine_with_local_llm
tools.description: Expand a short prompt into a Marble-optimised prompt via local Ollama

tools.name: generate_world_prompt
tools.description: Prompt template for world generation (world-gen)

tools.name: worldlabs_help
tools.description: Structured API reference at quick/standard/verbose detail levels

tools.name: gallery_explore
tools.description: Browse/search the public Marble community gallery + prompt mining

tools.name: worldlabs_shutdown
tools.description: Gracefully shut down the MCP server

tools.name: show_worlds_card
tools.description: Prefab card: world library overview

tools.name: show_world_card
tools.description: Prefab card: single world detail
